verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic uncaught-error capture via client libraries ("errors thrown by your application are automatically sent to our API"), JS/frontend automatic instrumentation and source-map support, and a generic exceptions API for backend reporting. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit confirmation of dedicated mobile SDKs (iOS/Android) or a list of officially supported backend languages beyond the Ruby CLI/gem reference, so mobile coverage is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit mobile SDK documentation, multi-language backend SDK list, independent hands-on verification of auto-capture across platforms.
